info.title: SafeBite API
info.description: AI-Powered Food Safety Intelligence REST API for Pakistani Packaged Foods (SRS v4.1 compliant). Supports native JWT auth (90-day mobile sessions), AWS S3 asset management, and user safety history, favorites, watchlist alerts, and consented health profiles.

servers.description: Active Server (Localhost, LAN, VS Code Port Tunnel, or Production)

tags.name: Auth
tags.description: Native JWT authentication and user profile management

tags.name: Storage
tags.description: AWS S3 image uploads, presigned URLs, and scoped asset management

tags.name: User Data
tags.description: Scan/search history, favorites, watchlist alerts, and consented health profile

post.summary: Register a new user account and send confirmation OTP
post.description: Validates strict email format, domain typos, disposable domains, password policy, and Unicode fullName; creates an unverified account (or refreshes a pending unverified account); and sends a 6-digit confirmation OTP via Mailtrap/SMTP.

example.message: Account created. Please check your email for the 6-digit verification code.

post.summary: Confirm new account email with 6-digit OTP and obtain JWT
post.description: Validates the 6-digit confirmation OTP (maximum 5 failed attempts), marks emailVerified=true, and issues the user's 90-day JWT Bearer token.

example.message: Email verified successfully. Account is now active.

400.description: Invalid/expired OTP, account already verified, lockout reached, or validation error.

value.message: Too many failed verification attempts. Please request a new code.

post.description: Dispatches a new 6-digit confirmation OTP for an unverified account (15-minute expiry, 30-second resend cooldown) without revealing whether an email is registered or already verified.

200.description: Generic acknowledgement returned without leaking account status

example.message: If an unverified account exists with that email, a 6-digit verification code has been sent.

post.summary: Request a 6-digit password reset OTP code
post.description: Step 1 of the 3-screen password reset workflow (Email -> Enter OTP -> New Password). Generates a single-use 6-digit OTP (15-minute expiry, 30-second resend cooldown) and dispatches it via configured Mailtrap/SMTP without leaking whether the email exists.

200.description: Generic acknowledgement returned without leaking account existence

example.message: If an account exists with that email, a 6-digit verification code has been sent.
Unable to send verification email at this time. Please try again later.

post.description: Step 2 of the password reset workflow. Validates the 6-digit OTP (maximum 5 failed attempts per code) and exchanges it for a short-lived single-use reset token (10-minute expiry).

200.description: OTP verified and single-use reset token issued

400.description: Request validation failed, OTP is invalid/expired, or maximum verification attempts exceeded.

value.message: Too many failed verification attempts. Please request a new code.

errors.message: Verification code must be a 6-digit number

post.summary: Complete password reset with verified token
post.description: Step 3 of the password reset workflow. Validates the single-use reset token from /api/auth/verify-reset-otp, updates the bcrypt password hash, consumes the reset session, and revokes all previously issued JWTs.

200.description: Password updated and existing JWT sessions invalidated

example.message: Password reset successfully. Please sign in with your new password.

400.description: Validation failed or reset session is invalid, already used, or expired.
